accessGaps: Research cutoff 2026-10-02T15:34:24.434Z; includes October 1 announcements after the previous cutoff. Public samples and focused signed-in X searches are not exhaustive, and no Grok scan is claimed.
12 repository paths returned errors; 10 public account candidates yielded no usable posts. Current chain identities override stale directory names where verified.

Channel briefs are AI-generated discovery summaries. Team-attributed rollouts and recovery claims remain developing when only secondary evidence is available; community allegations are not treated as findings.

SN44 Score's first linked alpha-burn transaction was checked successfully. Financial statements, other buyback totals, model benchmarks and most miner payouts were not independently audited; code publication is distinguished from live activation.
SN78 UMI preorders remain prospective and its public API still marks rewards inactive. SN120 Affine's new math pilot is nonpayable; the transition deadline does not automatically resume old payouts.

SN22 Desearch validator slowdown, SN44 Score scoring fixes, SN71 Leadpoet upstream scoring and SN118 Ditto unburn conditions remain unresolved independently. SN88 Investing's first distribution is primary-reported but not transaction-reconciled.

No completed SN104 TAOstatus mainnet activation, SN108 ChipForge launch, SN124 Swarm Sentinel public release or unrestricted SN94 Cathedral mining was located. SN55 NIOME's display fix is not evidence its earlier scoring investigation is closed; SN114 SOMA rerun completion remains unconfirmed.
SN82 identity remains unverified after re-registration; its flagged seven-day return is not attributed to the former project. SN26 Perturb/Kinitro identity discrepancies remain unresolved.

decisions.reason: SN78 UMI is covered for its primary SignVision wearable announcement and C5 enrollment progress. The 22.55% 24-hour alpha/TAO move is timestamped as attention, not causal proof, and pending preorders and rewards_active false prevent an inflated launch or five-star claim.

The 127.44% seven-day return spans the previously tracked deregistration/re-registration period. Current project identity and a fresh primary catalyst are unverified; the return is not evidence of a new launch by the former subnet project.

editorialDecisions: SN44 Score earns five stars for primary-reported long-term paying clients and break-even, plus a directly inspected successful alpha burn. Block 9190693 extrinsic 8 records 106.895289378 alpha burned and matches the team-linked owner address. Break-even is not profit. Main post and reply disagree on the last burn amount (4,444 versus 4,044), and their 1,044 labels were not reconciled with the first transaction amount. No aggregate burn total is published. No X posting is authorized for this October 2 run.

SN78 UMI SignVision is a concrete wearable proposal with an unnamed hardware partner and preorders opening soon; shipped devices, customer orders and revenue remain unconfirmed. The 22.553222% 24-hour alpha/TAO move is a discovery trigger and timestamped attention, not causal evidence or an automatic five-star rating. The public API returned 176 accepted submissions, intake_no_weight mode, rewards_active false and chain_submission_authorized false.

SN10 Pareton and SN53 engy already announced a partnership on September 30. The new October 1 counterpart statement confirms Pareton-tuned Qwen3.8 serving production traffic. No numerical latency gain from third-party replies is asserted; one joint story avoids duplicate coverage.

SN62 Ridges competition 29 was planned on September 25 and is now officially announced live. Database progress of 36%, 3,576 agents and 738 miners remains team-reported. Allocation targets were not reconciled with finalized payouts.

SN93 Bitcast figures are a primary founder report: Q3 revenue of $177,883, $123,000 in reported executed buybacks and roughly $78,000 still pending. No independent financial audit or $201,000 executed-buyback claim is implied.

SubConnect Revenue Index exceeds $50 million annualized run rate, not cash collected during the month. SN51 lium.io, SN4 Targon and SN53 engy are named drivers. A $100 million year-end scenario remains a conditional projection.

SN64 Chutes Parallax export records 738.3 billion training tokens, roughly 7.8 billion total parameters and 1.25 billion active parameters. It is a public MIT-licensed mid-training base checkpoint, not a completed 973-billion-token run, instruction/chat model, safety release or production deployment. This inspectable artifact is new beyond the September 29 phone demonstration.

SN91 Cascade primary comparison is 1.27% lower TIME CRPS and 0.40% lower TIME MASE, with 519 billion versus 3.36 trillion training tokens. The official reply confirms the token comparison. Public dashboard accessibility does not independently reproduce the benchmark or prove universal forecasting superiority. The receipt-verification fix was screened without adding a redundant second story.

SN80 OpenRoboto completed Novelty Search recap reports simulated success from about 55% to nearly 90%, not 90% real-hardware reliability. Shift and device partnerships were already covered and are not presented as new launches.

SN88 Investing first conviction distribution is a primary six-recipient ledger and a reported additional 36% annualized APY, not a guaranteed or one-day return. Owner, nonperpetual and wrong-target lock exclusions are attributed to the team. The prior first-payout watch is updated, but distributions were not independently transaction-reconciled. Portfolio guardrails remain acknowledged.

SN60 Bitsec active Sentios badge is visible in its public README. A proof-of-spend signal does not certify security or guarantee a vulnerability-free codebase. The September 30 continuous-audit service launch is not repeated as new.

SN38 ChronoLLM October 1 primary reply says it is early in the build after about 14 weeks of training, with a 16B model targeted later in October and 72B a longer-term goal. No new buyback, customer or revenue claim is inferred. The unrelated moderator complaint is omitted, and the prior attestation repair is not declared independently recovered or paid.

SN14 Cacheon Qwen customer arena will end in a few days according to the team-attributed secondary brief; it is not being migrated to replay. New replay code and evaluation-credit labels are verified, but all new arenas are not assumed live. SN15 ORO Race 11 is scheduled for October 2 noon PT / 19:00 UTC and remains upcoming at cutoff. Local practice does not qualify a miner for the network race.

SN46 Instant v0.1.3 has actual binary and signed-manifest assets. Disqualification requires at least two failed proofs and a failure share greater than 0.5%. Release publication is not proof every validator updated. SN74 Gittensor SparkInfer v0.6.4 benchmark is scoped to RTX 5090 and Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4, with improved first-token latency and the documented per-token tradeoff preserved.

SN22 Desearch crawl API is reachable, while its team-attributed brief says scoring is limited pending a validator performance fix. SN44 Score new PPE/fallen-person tasks and a zero-score reward bug remain secondary reports; no all-clear for the separate Person outage. SN71 Leadpoet recovery code is verified but upstream API recovery unconfirmed. SN118 Ditto incomplete-review classification is not misconduct or a ban; its fresh weight request does not prove paid emissions, and unburning remains conditional.

SN81 Reliquary routes are verified in public code: /corpus/tasks and /corpus/jobs/{job_id}/miners/{hotkey}, with cached background refresh and separate judge threads. Current endpoint completeness and actual payouts were not checked. Member allegations are not findings. The four-job launch was already covered October 1.

SN120 Affine current math-only pilot has 6,746 mining and 750 held-out tasks prepared; execution, real math-only epochs and learning gains are still unproven, with no chain weights from the pilot. The transition expires at 15:54:34 UTC today with no automatic fallback. Historical empty-window trials are separate from transition payments. Credential locations, development-host details and sensitive operational information are omitted.

SN5 Hone ordinary UID 0 exclusion fix is verified code, not observed new earnings. SN51 lium.io host-confirmed dead-GPU handling is enabled in the code path and can stop billing through the backend; its separate GPU-drop reporter is default-off and observational. SN105 Beam capped fraud-report rewards are a code change, not independently observed payout activation; Studio was already covered September 30.

Current top 12 emission recipients are SN51, SN64, SN4, SN120, SN107, SN53, SN44, SN8, SN80, SN3, SN68 and SN38. SN51, SN64, SN120, SN53, SN44, SN80 and SN38 are covered. SN4 B300/Bare Metal/Sandboxes were already covered; SN107 Studio and gene-editing promotion lack a fresh confirmed launch; SN8 six-hour buybacks were covered September 26 and later targets are not transactions; SN3 training has no newly verified milestone; SN68 quality-code changes are not a verified new production milestone.

SN104 TAOstatus testnet is live but its October 2 mainnet target has no located completion announcement. SN108 ChipForge targets October 2–3 with no verified activated challenge. SN124 Swarm Sentinel remains promised, SN94 Cathedral unrestricted mining unconfirmed, SN55 NIOME display fix does not resolve its prior scoring investigation, and SN114 SOMA rerun completion is unconfirmed. SN37 Aurelius validator registration and SN30 Endure lending teasers do not establish completed launches.

Moments lock reductions are indexed observations: SN25 UR 354,684.45 alpha at block 9193510, October 2 07:09:05.019 UTC; SN105 Beam 27,738.033 alpha at block 9193303, 06:28:32.163 UTC; SN88 Investing 10,323.671 alpha at block 9191191, October 1 23:28:31.727 UTC. SN17 paired 100-alpha lock/unlock events may be replacements, not exits. Six coldkey swaps at blocks 9192796, 9193265, 9193274, 9193279, 9193287 and 9193299 lack verified project-owner identity. No sale, motive or ownership transfer is inferred from indexer smart-money labels.

YouTube Videos latest public upload remains TmGJBuSoqrI, 31:03. Latest Live NAbCyYwZ_5w is now a completed 52:47 replay, broadcast October 1 despite an October 2 UTC watch-page publication date. Its shared entry is enabled false, listed true, upcoming false; it appears in Latest Episodes and Live, and is selected as the latest public player. FqFmRffEgVU remains the latest member video, with its actual 9:12 watch-page duration retained. Removed Shiz Cat, VUNE and Cascade IDs stay absent.

TAO Daily Montreal recap, SDK, cloud and Summer School articles were checked against seven prior editions and conference catch-ups. SN9 IOTA SDK targets this year rather than a new completed SDK; SN17 Game Jam winner was already published September 30; SN75 Hippius Shared Drives already launched, with only today’s v0.6.6 maintenance release new. Unrelated Chainlink, general crypto and StonkFun updates are excluded. Earlier reports and conference catch-ups are preserved.
